messages:
ashley_cs: Drafting a compact, customer-facing one-pager called 'Go-Live Armor' 62mdash; purpose: tie account health signals to immediate AM actions + ops run snippets (prefill/cache/batching/streaming). Short, copyable.

deploy-bot: Draft saved: https://redwood.docs/drafts/go-live-armor-1818000000 (expires in 72h)

tom_am: nice. can we include a 3-line phone/email script for renewal outreach? AMs love copy-paste. also a 1-min preflight checklist.

ashley_cs: yup. adding: 3-line outreach templates + 6-step preflight (dashboard checks, token budget, fallback owner, who to cc).

devin_eng: ops snippets incoming. include a ready-to-paste prefill toggle + streaming fallback example. small note: setting prefill.concurrency to 6-12 often cuts cold-start tail for chat flows.

devin_eng: ```yaml
# Ops snippet - drop into customer config
prefill:
  enabled: true
  concurrency: 10
  max_prefill_tokens: 400
  backoff_ms: 200
cache:
  ttl_seconds: 900
  eviction: lru
batching:
  target_latency_ms: 20
  max_batch_size: 24
streaming:
  client_chunk_size: 1024  # recommend < 1024 for client-side chunking
  server_reassembly: true
```

rita_pm: include a renewal-risk heuristic. proposal: sustained (48h) metrics: 1) error_rate > 0.5% OR 2) cache_miss_rate > 20% OR 3) p99 latency > 800ms AND change compared to baseline > 25% => flag for AM outreach. tiered by ARR.

ashley_cs: added that as "When to reach out" + included subject lines: "Quick check: performance impacting your integration" ; "Help to stabilize your Tenant X". Also added short checklist for customer call (what to ask, what logs to capture).

devin_eng: sample alert logic you can paste into dashboards: `expr: (sum(increase(tenant_errors_total[1h])) / sum(increase(tenant_requests_total[1h]))) > 0.005 and increase(tenant_cache_misses_total[2h]) / sum(increase(tenant_requests_total[2h])) > 0.2` -> route to #cs-alerts and page on-call. Widget names: "Tenant: P50/P95/P99 Latency", "Tenant: Error Rate", "Tenant: Cache Miss Rate", "Prefill Concurrency".

ashley_cs: also added a tiny math blurb for AMs so they understand tradeoffs: `warm_tokens_per_min = prefill.concurrency * avg_prefill_tokens * (60/avg_req_interval_s)`. helps set realistic prefill sizes vs cost.

rita_pm: can we include a short "What to tell the customer about quantization" note? customers ask if quality will drop. add a prompt-based eval they can run.

ashley_cs: done 62mdash; included 3 eval prompts and expected output style checks.

tom_am: love it. please publish and add to AM workspace. schedule a 15m walk-through tomorrow 9:00am PT? I'll invite.

ashley_cs: publishing now as a concise customer doc (intended to be customer-facing, not a long internals doc). tagging deploy-bot for PDF export.

deploy-bot: Export complete: S3://internal-docs/cs/go-live-armor-1818000000.pdf

ashley_cs: thanks all. will capture feedback after the AM walk-through and iterate.
